column5: Throws a spare head that diffuses into dark explosion on contact with the ground. The explosion is not big\, but it's powerful.
Swaps position of head and body. Due to the darkness\, it's hard to make out how it's done.
Attacks by spreading darkness at close range. It's possible to spread more if you input it multiple times.
Sends her head flying at the  enemy. If it hits\, it will stay close to the enemy. The neck is also dangerous to touch.
Spawns a giant head that travels forward. It hurts being hit by a big head like this.
Pulls the opponent with an attack from a head hidden underground. It does no damage\, but it cannot be guarded.
Uses a giant scythe to strike at the opponent. The scythe is very long\, so it has a blindspot.
Fires a beam from the eyes. It's more powerful than her usual laser attack.
Spew heads out from her empty neck. The heads will try to return into the neck\, but they can't chase it.
Fades into the darkness\, and then do a counter attack if the opponent touches it.
Jumps above the enemy and spins like a drill. This move has nothing to do with being a Dullahan or Rokurokubi\, so it's a questionable attack.
Spins the head\, causing a little tornado effect. With that kind of speed\, anyone would be confused too.
Dash forward and strike at the opponent. Being hit by this attack strikes terror as if being cut by a Reaper.
Fires beam from eyes. It's a powerful laser attack\, but it seems she can keep it up for a decent amount of time
The Dullahan's head splits into two. It will fire projectiles for a certain amount of time.
The Dullahan's head splits into three and fires projectiles. Perhaps she can split into more heads.
Fires beam from eyes. It's a very powerful attack that affects a huge area\, and she seem to be firing them blindly.
For a certain period of time\, a neck will be attached to the head. It seemse that she's trying to set a new record in neck stretch length.
Moves forward while paving the road in darkness. The road of the Dullahan is quite gloomy.
Create a dark tornado by spinning at very fast speed. This attack really has no relation with being rokurokubi or dullahan.
Disappears into darkness and waits for the opponent to make a move. If they make an attack\, misfortune will befall them.
Spreads a dark fog repeatedly. It's a fast attack and she is invincible at the start\, but it's still a bullet so it can be grazed.
